message: Tool 'web_search' (mcp__web_search_mcp_web_search) consistently errors with generic 'Error: Error calling tool web_search' via MCP, and reproduces as CLI 'uv run web-search-cli search web' with exit_code=12, IndexError: tuple index out of range. quick_web_search and gemini_search paths work. Likely a provider-merging / result-tuple unpacking regression on the multi-provider web_search aggregation path. Env: duckdb analytics locked by PID 3240 (separate issue).
